title: PolicyProfile
description: Schema for a 9TEVE-OS Control Plane policy profile. Profiles define which actions require approval and which are denied outright.

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for the policy profile.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this profile enforces.

side_effect_actions.description: Exhaustive list of action types considered side-effects (have external impact).

deny_action_types.description: Action types that are always denied by this profile, regardless of context.

require_approval_for.description: Action types that must receive explicit human approval before proceeding.

default_decision.description: Decision applied to actions not listed in deny_action_types or require_approval_for.

examples.description: Require human approval for side-effect actions; allow all others.
Deny all side-effect actions; allow all others.
Allow all actions without requiring approval.
